heroHeadline: Two Young Women Killed in Tepito Over Independence Day as Unión Tepito Turf War's Toll Passes 11, While Brugada Unveils Selene Works and Rains Flood the City
heroSubtitle: Odette Rosas, 18, and Abigail Herrera, 19, were shot dead by motorcycle gunmen in the early hours of September 16 as they left Independence Day celebrations near Tepito's Mercado 14 — accused by the Anti-Unión faction of 'betraying' them to rival La Unión Tepito. The killing extends the Centro Histórico turf war to at least 11 dead since early August, even as Jefa de Gobierno Clara Brugada pressed ahead on other fronts: announcing priority works for Colonia Selene in Tláhuac on September 10 (school renovations, a lit 'Camino de Mujeres Libres y Seguras,' Cablebús construction and a new Utopía center), while heavy rain on September 12 flooded eight boroughs, downed a 25-meter tree on Eje 7, and forced a slow-speed 'marcha de seguridad' across multiple Metro lines.
